shortDescription.default: Displays competencies with their leaders and staff, with filtering and people search.

longDescription.default: Full-page Competency Matrix web part for SharePoint Online. Reads a Competencies list and a Staff list (linked via a lookup field) using PnPjs, groups staff under each competency, and supports filtering by competency and searching for a person to see which competencies they belong to.

features.title: Competency Matrix Feature
features.description: Deploys the Competency Matrix web part
